objective_checks.detail: all pinned refs carry version comments

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: All four marketplace action refs (checkout, setup-node, setup-python, gh-release) across both ci.yml and release.yaml were pinned to full commit SHAs with version comments retained, covering every workflow file.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The agent correctly left the local action (`./.github/actions/local-lint`) and the Docker ref (`docker://alpine:3.20`) untouched and made no unrelated changes.

dimensions.name: Communication
dimensions.rationale: It clearly stated what was pinned and why local/docker refs were excluded, but never explained how the SHAs were resolved or verified, which the rubric explicitly asks for.
